verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a fair axis for a SaaS billing product, but the evidence pack documents no in-product assistant that users can delegate tasks to. The official MCP server lets external AI agents call the Stripe API, which is a developer building block and a different story, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
